methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched via WebFetch for Aircall (aircall.io/pricing — dynamic, placeholders only), CloudTalk (cloudtalk.io/pricing — EUR prices render), Twilio Flex (twilio.com/en-us/flex/pricing — all models render), Five9 (five9.com/products/pricing — Digital/Core render, Plus/Pro/Enterprise contact-sales), Talkdesk (talkdesk.com/pricing — all four prices render), NICE CXone (nice.com/websites/pricing — all five suites render), and Nextiva (nextiva.com/contact-center/pricing — Essential renders, Pro/Premium contact-sales). Genesys (genesys.com/pricing) and Dialpad (dialpad.com/pricing — HTTP 403) do not render plan prices in static HTML; their plan rows are corroborated from multiple independent 2026 guides citing official documentation and noted accordingly. Compliance was verified on official trust/security pages: SOC 2 Type 2 + GDPR confirmed on aircall.io/security (HIPAA/BAA NOT stated there — corrected to null); HIPAA + SOC 2 Type 2 + GDPR on cloudtalk.io/security; Five9 HIPAA/BAA on five9.com/legal/HIPAA and SOC 2 + GDPR via Five9 Trust Center (GDPR corrected to true); Twilio Flex HIPAA-eligible with BAA per twilio.com/en-us/hipaa (BAA corrected to true). All prices are per named user/agent per month billed monthly unless noted as concurrent or hybrid. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Aircall
vendors.provenance: Pricing corroborated via WebSearch from multiple 2026 guides citing aircall.io/pricing ($40/$70 monthly, $30/$50 annual per license); official page rendered dynamic placeholders only. Compliance fetched from aircall.io/security: SOC 2 Type 2 and GDPR explicitly stated; HIPAA and BAA are NOT stated on the trust page (third-party sources indicate HIPAA/BAA only via Enterprise/Custom on request), so vendor-level HIPAA/BAA corrected from true to null.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Per license per month ($30/license billed annually, $40 billed monthly). Minimum 3 licenses. Includes unlimited simultaneous outbound calls, call recording, 250+ integrations. AI Assist add-on $9/license/month extra (AI Assist Pro $49/license/month).

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Per license per month ($50/license billed annually, $70 billed monthly). Minimum 3 licenses. Adds Salesforce CTI, advanced analytics, power dialer features.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Minimum 25 licenses. Custom pricing via sales. Includes dedicated onboarding, SLA, and enterprise security features. HIPAA/BAA reportedly available only on this Enterprise/Custom tier via sales.

limits: Minimum 3 licenses on Essentials and Professional
Minimum 25 licenses on Custom plan
AI Assist charged separately at $9/license/month (Pro $49/license/month)
HIPAA/BAA not stated on trust page; reportedly Enterprise/Custom only
keyFeatures: AI Voice Agents with 50 free minutes/month per account
250+ integrations and open API
Click-to-dial softphone across desktop and mobile
Power dialer on Professional and above

vendors.name: Twilio Flex
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched directly from twilio.com/en-us/flex/pricing; all billing models confirmed (5,000 free hours one-time, $1/active user hour, $150/named user, $35/user+usage). Twilio Flex is HIPAA-eligible and Twilio signs BAAs (Security/Enterprise editions) per twilio.com/en-us/hipaa — vendor-level BAA corrected from null to true; compliance source corrected from the pricing page to the HIPAA page.

plans.name: Free Trial
plans.notes: 5,000 free active user hours for new Twilio Flex accounts only (one-time grant, not recurring; expires on selecting a billing model). Underlying Twilio service charges still apply. This is a trial, not a forever-free tier.

plans.name: Active User Hour
plans.notes: $1 per active user hour (consumption-based, no fixed monthly fee — monthlyUsd null). Pay only when agents are logged in and active. Plus underlying Twilio service usage charges.

plans.name: Named User
plans.notes: $150 per named user per month. Covers agents, supervisors, administrators, and developers. Flat predictable spend. Requires contract. Underlying Twilio service charges billed separately.

plans.name: User + Usage
plans.notes: $35 per monthly active user plus metered usage for Conversations, TaskRouter, Studio, and other Twilio services. Available only on existing Twilio accounts (not Flex-only accounts).

limits: 5,000 free hours is one-time trial grant, not a free tier
User+Usage model requires existing Twilio account
Named User requires contract commitment
Underlying Twilio API costs (voice, SMS, etc.) are always additional
BAA requires Twilio Security or Enterprise Edition
keyFeatures: Fully programmable CCaaS on Twilio platform
Three flexible billing models including per-hour consumption
Agent Copilot AI: $0.035/min voice, $0.005/message digital
Unlimited customization via React-based UI framework
bestFor: Developer-led teams building custom contact centers
Companies with variable or seasonal agent staffing
